attempts.summary: Configured node1 (RHEL10) to require new user passwords to be at least 12 characters and use at least 3 different character classes via pam_pwquality (minlen=12, minclass=3 in /etc/security/pwquality.conf, wired into both system-auth and password-auth). Verified enforcement end-to-end as a real non-root user before and after a full node restart, then completed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol.
